author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
I was using AI skills wrong. You don't need a skill for something AI already does well. You need one for the things it keeps getting wrong, or the behaviors you want to change.

In this video, I introduce titstack, my collection of AI skills, and walk through how I use them to make AI work the way I want. From more natural YouTube thumbnails to repeatable book publishing workflows and Linux desktop troubleshooting, the goal is to spend less time repeating the same corrections.

We cover:
- When you actually need an AI skill
- Keeping AI thumbnails natural and preserving real people
- Using Photocraft for editable, layered images
- Standardizing mdBook and Amazon KDP publishing workflows
- Giving AI context about your Linux environment
- Adapting skills for Claude, Codex, and local models
- Why downloading every skill isn't the answer

Use these examples as a starting point, then tailor them to your own workflow.
